title: Degree-two vanishing for the infinitesimal units kernel
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $f:C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ a separated finite-type scheme of dimension at most one [def-sc-curves]. Let $i:C_{\mathrm{red}}\to C$ be the reduction [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction] and $\varphi:i^{-1}\mathbf G_{m,C}\to\mathbf G_{m,C_{\mathrm{red}}}$ the transpose of restriction of units [def-sc-gm-torsor] under the adjunction [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let $K=\ker\varphi$ be its kernel in the category of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] (sections mapped to the identity). Then $H^2((C_{\mathrm{red}})_{\mathrm{Et}},K)=0$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Empty, zero-dimensional and disconnected curves are allowed; no smoothness, properness or reducedness is assumed.

source.place: Proof, Step 1 and the following Claim; proof text retained in the parent DAG node

proof.text: Finite type over the field makes C Noetherian. Apply the geometric finite filtration theorem to obtain E_0 isomorphic to the reduction units kernel, E_n zero, and short exact sequences with successive quotients inverse images of lifted associated quasi-coherent sheaves.

For every quasi-coherent F on C, compare its Zariski module cohomology with the underlying abelian cohomology. The Noetherian dimension bound dim C<=1 makes H^2 zero. The etale/Zariski comparison identifies this with H^2(F_et); its two Ext universes are compared through the common standard derived category. The coefficient-lift comparison then gives vanishing for the lifted associated etale sheaf.

Reduction is a universal homeomorphism. Its cohomology equivalence transfers the preceding vanishing to each pulled-back quotient. Starting at E_n=0, decreasing induction on j and exactness of H^2(S.X1)->H^2(S.X2)->H^2(S.X3) give vanishing for each E_j. Transport the j=0 result through the first-term isomorphism.
